Democrats are fearmongering — there are NO provisions in the House Budget bill that cut Social Security, Medicare, or Medicaid. Don't believe me? Read the bill for yourself.  

This bill is a blueprint to accomplish President Trump's agenda: lower taxes, securing the border, and lowering energy costs. THAT'S what Democrats are voting against.

🚨The House just PASSED the Republican Budget Resolution to jumpstart President Trump’s America First Agenda! 🇺🇸

Here’s the truth: this budget does NOT cut Social Security, Medicare, or Medicaid. 

This budget will allow us to lower taxes, cut energy costs, secure the border, and root out waste, fraud, and corruption — putting money back in the hands of hardworking families. Read the bill for yourself.

Yet, 214 Democrats chose fearmongering over facts, voting against relief for everyday Americans. Shameful.

Today, I introduced the bipartisan Improving Law Enforcement Officer Safety and Wellness Through Data Act to protect those who protect us.

342 officers were shot in 2024—50 killed. Already this year, 58 more have been shot, including 9 ambushed. And that’s just what’s been reported — many incidents go untracked.

This bill will close reporting gaps, expose violent trends, and ensure officers have access to the mental health care they deserve.

The Improving Law Enforcement Officer Safety and Wellness Through Data Act is one step closer to becoming law!

Today, @JudiciaryGOP advanced this bill out of committee to improve how we track and respond to attacks on our men and women in blue.

Tomorrow, the House is voting on my bill — the Improving Law Enforcement Officer Safety and Wellness Through Data Act!

I'm honored that the White House issued a statement in support of this legislation to better protect law enforcement officers on the job.

Let’s get it done. https://t.co/W8s3UaQs1I

So far this year: 
➡️109 police officers shot
➡️12 killed
➡️21 ambush-style attacks

It needs to end.

Today, the House is voting on my bill, H.R. 2240, to protect law enforcement, prevent targeted attacks & support their mental health. We owe them real action. https://t.co/UHKoAoQXsL

I just passed my first bill out of the U.S. House.

I couldn't be prouder that it's a bipartisan bill that supports our men and women in law enforcement — the Improving Law Enforcement Officer Safety and Wellness Through Data Act.

This bill confronts the growing threats our officers face amid rising anti-police sentiment, ensuring they have the support and mental health resources they need to stay safe on the job.
